mainEntity.name: Are there energy-efficient door options available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many energy-efficient door options are available to help reduce heating and cooling costs. Features to look for include insulated cores, multiple panes of glass (for doors with windows), low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, and robust weatherstripping around the frame. Materials like fiberglass and steel with foam cores generally offer better insulation than solid wood. Investing in energy-efficient doors can improve your home's comfort, reduce drafts, and contribute to lower utility bills over time, especially in varying climates.
